flags.issue: The big jump only half-lands. The shuttered building is swapped in one frame for the cafe (round window, striped awning, paper lanterns, noren, red stall at right) and crosswalk stripes appear. But the left half of the frame, the dominant stair and bridge, is untouched: still cold grey-blue concrete with no lanterns, no greenery and no lit steps. It reads as a prefab swap on one building, not a transformation of the place. The new crosswalk is also broken into floating, misaligned tile slabs instead of continuous white bars.
flags.fix: Have the stage-1 jump also hit the stair and bridge: at least warm under-step LED strips and two or three glowing paper lanterns on the stair rail, plus a warm tint on the bridge underside. Rebuild the crosswalk as continuous, evenly spaced white bars that read clearly under the reflections.

flags.issue: No visible change from stage 1. Only the rain particles differ.
flags.fix: Give this stage a visible addition from the end image, e.g. a warm string-light run along the bridge railing.
Add hanging greenery or ivy spilling over the bridge parapet.
Light the stair treads with warm amber strips and add a tall paper lantern at the stair base.
Add the cyan neon underglow strip along the bridge's lower edge and the coffee-cup neon sign on the bridge fascia.

flags.issue: No visible change from stage 5. Five straight dead stages (2 to 6) make the story stall.
flags.fix: Add the chalkboard sandbox sign and potted plants at the stair foot, and warm-lit glass storefront panels at far left.

flags.issue: The only change is a faint row of tiny string-light dots far behind the bridge, near the vanishing point. At this angle it is almost invisible.
flags.fix: Put the string lights on the near bridge railing and stair, with larger bulbs and real bloom, so they light the scene warmly and are obvious at a glance.

flags.issue: Change from stage 7 is negligible, at most a few more distant bulbs.
flags.fix: Add wisteria and purple flowers hanging from the bridge, as in the end image.
Shift the overall color grade warmer (amber on the wet pavement and stair) to start pulling away from the cold blue start look.

flags.issue: No visible change from stage 9. Four flat stages (7 to 10) after five dead ones (2 to 6).
flags.fix: Light the convenience store under the bridge with its bright orange/blue sign band, and add warm downlights under the bridge deck.

flags.issue: Ivy, wisteria and warm upper windows on the cafe are a real and readable step. But all the progress since stage 1 is on one building, and the left 60% of the frame is still the stage-0 scene.
flags.fix: Keep this stage, and move the stair and bridge dressing earlier so this step has company.

flags.issue: The final stage adds a blown-out cyan-white block at the top of the cafe. Bloom washes it into an unreadable glare blob instead of a legible neon sign, and the pink vertical kanji neon from the end image is missing. Worse, the sequence ends at about half the end image: the stair, bridge, lanterns, string lights, greenery on the bridge, warm grade and lit storefronts on the left were never delivered.
flags.fix: Cut the sign's emissive and bloom so it reads as a teal kanji sign, and add the pink vertical 茶房雫 neon on the right. Make sure the final stage includes the full stair and bridge makeover and the warm grade so stage 12 actually matches the end image.

verdict: Fails as a progression. Stage 0 is a faithful stylized match for the start image, and stage 1 delivers the expected big jump, but only on the right-hand building. The stair and bridge, which fill most of the frame and carry the end image's identity (lanterns, string lights, greenery, glowing steps, cyan underglow), are never transformed. Stages 2 to 10 are effectively frozen: five identical frames, then distant string-light dots too small to see. Only stages 11 and 12 add the ivy and a sign, and the sign is a glare blob. The sequence ends about halfway to the target. Spread the stair and bridge transformation across stages 2 to 10 and fix the stage-12 sign and crosswalk.
